title: Mass Greeting
text:
PRIEST: The Lord be with you.
PEOPLE: And with your spirit.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Gratia Domini nostri Iesu Christi, et caritas Dei, et communicatio Sancti Spiritus sit cum omnibus vobis. / Et cum spiritu tuo.
